votes.quote: The bug: `spec.md` says a candidate of zero must return `Infinity`. The code at `src/octaveAdjustedTempoError.ts:5` checks `!(candidate >= 0)`, which lets zero through. So `octaveAdjustedTempoError(0, 120)` returns `1` instead of `Infinity`.
